Use case: style-transfer.
Edit image 1, the four-card concept board. Image 2 is the existing Finn master artwork and is STRICTLY a reference for the clean adult cartoon rendering language, not a character to insert.
Keep all four card subjects and their EXACT counts: four chili peppers, four icebergs, four separate potted plants, four cake slices. Keep top-left "4" and bottom-right upside-down "4" on each, consistent suit symbols, identical rounded corners, four front-facing cards in one straight row on navy.
Change the rendering to strongly match the character reference: much more graphic adult animated television cartoon, confident thick black contour lines, smooth flat saturated fills, only ONE hard-edged cel shadow per object. Simplify the interiors and backgrounds. No detailed painterly shading, glowing gradients or elaborate realism. Keep a few stylish midnight lounge furnishings as context. Objects should look lively and witty through silhouette and pose, with NO faces and NO human characters.
Make card proportions wider and shorter, like actual 63x88mm poker cards, consistent width-to-height 0.716. Retain generous space between cards. Overall board wide with complete card edges visible.
Simplify thick suit-colored frames into graphic embossed flame, droplet, leaf and sun motifs with subtle metallic accent lines. Strong copper red, cobalt blue, emerald green, amber gold. No rainbow haze or glow. Keep the very readable bold cream numerals with dark outlines. No descriptions or other text. This is a cohesive original cartoon deck for 100next.
special:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Use the supplied four-number-card image ONLY as a reference for the cohesive 100next Midnight Social Club card style. Create ONE new concept board showing FOUR SPECIAL CARDS arranged in a spacious TWO BY TWO GRID. Portrait board; cards in each cell have standard playing-card 63:88 proportions (width divided by height = 0.716), front-on, complete rounded edges visible, identical dimensions and even gaps. Plain navy behind cards. This is a first design mockup, no headings outside the cards.
Style: finished lively adult television cartoon matching the reference, clean thick near-black ink, crisp flat saturated colors, one simple cel shadow, warm brass details and midnight lounge props. Witty premium cartoon art, not realistic fantasy, not anime. Bold readable graphic suit frames: fire copper red, water cobalt blue, leaf emerald green, sun amber gold. Subtle etched motif framing, no rainbow haze or sparkly particle overlays.
Each card has a clearly readable horizontal ACTION WORD at TOP LEFT, the same action word ROTATED 180 degrees at BOTTOM RIGHT, with the corresponding suit symbol at both corners. Reserve adequate wide corner panels so long words fit without cropping. Cream bold Luckiest Guy-like heavy block lettering, strong dark outlines. These are action labels IN PLACE OF numeric rank indices, do not put 7, 8, 9, or 10 as rank numbers.
Each special has a small clean warm-ivory instruction plaque near the lower central art area, NOT colliding with the inverted index. Plaque text must be rendered verbatim.
TOP LEFT - FIRE CHOOSE:
Corner word: "CHOOSE".
Art: a large cartoon gold-and-red spotlight selector pointer over a stylized little fan of three player silhouette tokens on a crimson velvet card table; exactly one token is highlighted. Large clear arrow pointer is a PERSISTENT dominant visual symbol. Dynamic witty cartoon nightclub prop scene, no actual human bodies or anatomical hands.
Plaque: "CHOOSE PLAYER" and underneath "Choose who plays next."
TOP RIGHT - WATER REVERSE:
Corner word: "REVERSE".
Art: a lounge record turntable with TWO BIG chunky turquoise water ribbon arrows making opposite curling loops around it, very distinct arrowheads and strong rotating composition, ice-blue splashes kept contained within illustration. The reverse emblem remains large and readable, NOT a tiny basic flat arrow. Make it dramatic, witty and visually rich.
Plaque: "REVERSE" and underneath "Reverse the turn order."
BOTTOM LEFT - LEAF ZERO:
Corner word: "ZERO".
Art: an elegant leafy brass pause medallion with two unmistakable vertical pause bars, gently held by big curling green leaves above a calm velvet lounge cushion; the illustration communicates HOLD/PAUSE, not erasing or resetting a counter. Oversized pause symbol persists in the illustration.
Plaque: "ZERO" and underneath "Keep the total unchanged."
BOTTOM RIGHT - SUN MINUS TEN:
Corner word: "-10".
Art: a cartoon brass coin dispenser with an oversized gold sunburst shield prominently embossed "-10", swooping golden subtraction motif and a small group of departing golden coins, sunny amber lounge scene. Strong central "-10" emblem remains permanently visible.
Plaque: "MINUS TEN" and underneath "Subtract 10 from the total."
All text accurate and legible; no other descriptions, no unrelated numbers, no human characters, no logos or watermark. Emphasize clear mobile readability and consistent deck grammar.
